title: Strawberry Glazed Mochi Donuts
hookLine: Bouncy gluten-free sweet rice bubbles dipped in glossy freeze-dried strawberry glaze.

items.name: Silken tofu or warm coconut milk

steps.title: Preheat Air Fryer & Measure Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your air fryer to 330°F (165°C) for 3 minutes and line the basket with perforated parchment or a light oil mist. Measure out {mochiko}, {tofu}, and {sugar_m} in a mixing bowl so they combine evenly.

steps.title: Knead Bouncy Mochi Balls
steps.instructionTemplate: Mix {mochiko}, {sugar_m}, and {tofu} until a smooth play-dough texture forms. Roll into 48 mini spheres and connect 8 spheres per ring on parchment squares.

steps.title: Air Fry or Flash Fry Golden
steps.instructionTemplate: Mist lightly with oil and air-fry at 360°F (180°C) for 8 minutes (or fry 2 mins per side) until puffed and crisp outside. Work in small batches so the oil temperature stays steady, frying for 2–3 minutes per side until deeply golden and crisp all around.
steps.creatorSecret: Leaving the parchment square underneath makes transferring delicate rings effortless—peel paper away after 60 seconds.

steps.title: Dip in Strawberry Mirror Glaze
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {powdered}, {berry}, and 2 tbsp warm milk until silky. Dip warm donut tops and finish with crisp sugar pearls. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.

ugcQuotes.quote: So chewy inside and genuinely took 20 mins in my air fryer!
